link.instructions: The CCDI DCC model is a graph database schema. model-desc/ccdi-dcc-model.yml describes the model nodes. model-desc/ccdi-dcc-model-props.yml describes the node properties.
The Explore Participants view enables browsing and filtering by study, participant, and sample attributes. The Explore Files view focuses on file-based attributes.
